command:
source scripts/tex_environment.sh
python3 flatten_sources.py
for pass in 1 2 3; do flags=(); if [[ "$pass" -lt 3 ]]; then flags=(-no-pdf); fi; xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${flags[@]}" main.tex > main.pass$pass.log.txt 2>&1 || exit $?; done
cp single.tex single_build/book_single.tex
cd single_build
for pass in 1 2 3; do flags=(); if [[ "$pass" -lt 3 ]]; then flags=(-no-pdf); fi; xelatex -interaction=nonstopmode -halt-on-error "${flags[@]}" book_single.tex > book_single.pass$pass.log.txt 2>&1 || exit $?; done
scope: Book modular and standalone rebuild after two documented layout-only fixes. Report modular and standalone builds remain initial_four_build_run.json.
